public_rationale: Anthropic documents a March defect that caused repeated forgetfulness, repetition and poor tool choices. A separate contemporaneous user report records frequent interventions in complex workflows. Together these support the ordinary reading of substantial practical limitations, without requiring a numerical definition of perfection. The conclusion concerns March behavior, not every later version.
limitations: The evidence does not establish a universal failure rate.
The firsthand log report is not a controlled benchmark, and its causal explanation is unproven.
Anthropic reports fixing the caching defect on April 10; the evidence therefore does not imply that this particular defect persisted.
